prompt_en: Photorealistic vertical smartphone photograph at a rooftop telescope-repair table during blue hour. Treat Image 1 solely as a visible adult appearance reference: one clearly adult woman with long dark wavy hair, visible natural facial proportions, and real skin texture. She crouches among rooftop deck boards, a low parapet, warm work bulbs, a folded blank route map, translucent calibration tokens, and a small telescope; she sorts tokens with one hand and raises one translucent token toward the elevated camera while looking up. The camera is close above her and points steeply downward; the camera is visibly close above one clearly adult subject and points steeply downward toward the repair table. A readable ground or floor plane surrounds the subject and anchors the vertical separation with rooftop deck boards. The subject's face gaze or raised hand responds toward the elevated camera position while presenting one translucent token. Head torso limbs and one near prop follow coherent top-down foreshortening and scale change from token to parapet. A drone landscape eye-level crop telephoto view or isolated stretched limb does not substitute for the close elevated camera relation. A 0.5x ultra-wide smartphone look creates separately inspectable near-to-far scale behavior: the raised token and hand are conspicuously enlarged, then the head, torso, bent limbs, repair table, and parapet recede rapidly yet coherently; this lens behavior remains secondary to the visible camera-ground-subject relation. Cosmetic pigment begins visibly on both high cheekbones beneath the elevated camera. The pigment remains continuously readable along an upward-outward path toward both temples on the gently turned adult face. Soft tapered edges thin gradually at the temple ends while preserving a recognizable blush hue under mixed blue and warm light. Facial anatomy contour stripes cast shadow and colored lighting do not substitute for the continuous cosmetic pigment path. Her lips retain natural ridges beneath a continuous glossy cosmetic film, with clean curved wet specular bands across both lips and slightly richer inner color; this remains visibly a cosmetic lip finish. Direct compact flash mixes with warm bulbs and cool ambient light, while the unfinished sorting gesture keeps the photograph candid.
